units.source_text: 我这里是‘穷乡僻壤无莺啭’也！”

en.t: Here where I am, it is a poor, remote place where no warbler sings!

units.source_text: 源氏读了诗，很同情她的孤寂，便顾不得元旦忌讳，淌下数行眼泪来。

en.t: Genji read the poem and felt deep sympathy for her loneliness; forgetting the taboos of New Year's Day, he shed several lines of tears.

units.source_text: 源氏对小女公子说：“这信应该由你自己答复。

en.t: Genji said to the young lady, "You should answer this letter yourself.
You must not withhold the voice of the early warbler!"

units.source_text: 便拿过笔砚来，要她写回信。

en.t: He then brought over brush and inkstone and urged her to write a reply.

units.source_text: 这小女公子长得十分美丽，朝夕见惯的人也百看不厌。

en.t: This young lady was so beautiful that even those who saw her morning and evening never tired of looking at her.

units.source_text: 源氏使她们母女隔绝，经年累月不得相见，实乃罪过之事，想起了心中不胜痛苦。

en.t: When Genji thought how he had separated mother and daughter and kept them from seeing each other for years, he felt it was truly sinful and his heart was unbearably pained.
